p.i: A revelation given at Kirtland, Ohio, 9 May 1831, through Joseph Smith Jr. to Joseph Wakefield, Parley P. Pratt, John Corrill, Edward Partridge, and the elders of the church.

chapter.li: LEChapter50 Verse1 Hearken, O you elders of my church, and give ear to the voice of the living God, and attend to the words of wisdom which shall be given unto you, according as you have asked and are agreed, as touching the church, and the spirits which have gone abroad in the earth. VerseEnd Verse2 Behold, truly I say unto you that there are many spirits which are false spirits, which have gone forth in the earth deceiving the world, VerseEnd Verse3 and also Satan has sought to deceive you that he might overthrow you. VerseEnd

Verse4 Behold, I, the Lord, have looked upon you, and have seen abominations in the church which professes my name. VerseEnd Verse5 But blessed are they who are faithful and endure, whether in life or in death, for they shall inherit eternal life. VerseEnd Verse6 But woe be unto them that are deceivers and hypocrites, for thus says the Lord: I will bring them to judgment. VerseEnd Verse7 Behold, truly I say unto you, there are hypocrites among you and have deceived some, which has given the adversary power. But behold, such shall be reclaimed. VerseEnd Verse8 But the hypocrites shall be detected and shall be cut off, either in life or in death, even as I will. And woe unto them who are cut off from my church, for the same are overcome of the world. VerseEnd Verse9 Wherefore, let every man beware, so that he doesn't do that which is not in truth and righteousness before me. VerseEnd

Verse10 And now come, says the Lord by the spirit unto the elders of his church, and let us reason together that you may understand. VerseEnd Verse11 Let us reason even as a man reasons, one with another, face to face. VerseEnd Verse12 Now, when a man reasons he is understood of man because he reasons as a man; even so will I, the Lord, reason with you that you may understand. VerseEnd Verse13 Wherefore, I, the Lord, ask you this question: Unto what were you ordained? VerseEnd Verse14 To preach my gospel by the spirit, even the Comforter, which was sent forth to teach the truth. VerseEnd Verse15 And then received you spirits which you could not understand, and received them to be of God. And in this are you justified? VerseEnd Verse16 Behold, you shall answer this question yourselves. Nevertheless, I will be merciful unto you; he that is weak among you, hereafter shall be made strong. VerseEnd

Verse17 Truly I say unto you, he that is ordained of me and sent forth to preach the word of truth by the Comforter, in the spirit of truth, does he preach it by the spirit of truth or some other way? VerseEnd Verse18 And if by some other way, it is not of God. VerseEnd Verse19 And again, he that receives the word of truth, does he receive it by the spirit of truth or some other way? VerseEnd Verse20 If it be some other way, it is not of God. VerseEnd Verse21 Therefore, why is it that you cannot understand and know that he that receives the word by the spirit of truth, receives it as it is preached by the spirit of truth? VerseEnd Verse22 Wherefore, he that preaches and he that receives, understand one another, and both are edified and rejoice together. VerseEnd Verse23 And that which does not edify is not of God, and is darkness. VerseEnd Verse24 That which is of God is light, and he that receives light and continues in God receives more light, and that light grows brighter and brighter until the perfect day. VerseEnd

Verse25 And again, truly I say unto you, and I say it that you may know the truth, that you may chase darkness from among you. VerseEnd Verse26 For he that is ordained of God and sent forth, the same is appointed to be the greatest, notwithstanding he is least and the servant of all. VerseEnd Verse27 Wherefore, he is possessor of all things, for all things are subject unto him both in Heaven and on the earth: the life and the light, the spirit and the power, sent forth by the will of the Father through Jesus Christ, his Son. VerseEnd Verse28 But no man is possessor of all things except he be purified and cleansed from all sin. VerseEnd Verse29 And if you are purified and cleansed from all sin, you shall ask whatever you will in the name of Jesus, and it shall be done. VerseEnd Verse30 But know this, it shall be given you what you shall ask.

And as you are appointed to the head, the spirits shall be subject unto you. VerseEnd Verse31 Wherefore, it shall come to pass that if you behold a spirit manifested that you cannot understand, and you receive not that spirit, you shall ask of the Father in the name of Jesus, and if he give not unto you that spirit, then you may know that it is not of God. VerseEnd Verse32 And it shall be given unto you power over that spirit, and you shall proclaim against that spirit with a loud voice that it is not of God, VerseEnd Verse33 not with railing accusation, that you be not overcome, neither with boasting nor rejoicing, so that you be not VerseEnd Verse34 seized therewith. He that receives of God, let him account it of God, and let him rejoice that he is accounted of God worthy VerseEnd Verse35 to receive. And by giving heed and doing these things which you have received and which you shall hereafter receive, behold, the Kingdom is given unto you of the Father and power to overcome all things which are not ordained VerseEnd Verse36 of him. And behold, truly I say unto you, blessed are you who hear these words of mine from the mouth of my servant, for your sins are forgiven you. VerseEnd

Verse37 Let my servant Joseph Wakefield, in whom I am well pleased, and my servant Parley, go forth among the churches and strengthen them by the word of exhortation, VerseEnd Verse38 and also my servant John Corrill, or as many of my servants as are ordained unto this office, and let them labor in the vineyard. And let no man hinder them of doing that which I have appointed unto them. VerseEnd Verse39 Wherefore, in this thing my servant Edward is not justified. Nevertheless, let him repent and he shall be forgiven. VerseEnd

Verse40 Behold, you are little children and you cannot bear all things now. You must grow in grace and in the knowledge of the truth. VerseEnd Verse41 Fear not, little children, for you are mine, and I have overcome the world, and you are of them which my Father has given me, VerseEnd Verse42 and none of them which my Father has given me shall be lost. VerseEnd Verse43 And the Father and I are one. I am in the Father and the Father in me. And inasmuch as you have received me, you are in me and I in you; VerseEnd Verse44 wherefore, I am in your midst. And I am the good shepherd, VerseEnd Verse45 and the day comes that you shall hear my voice, and see me, and know that I am. VerseEnd Verse46 Watch, therefore, that you may be ready. Even so, Amen. VerseEnd
